verse.name: v1a
verse.lines:
The world may fail
You will remain

verse.name: v1b
verse.lines:
In the midst of the trial
You will always be

verse.name: v1c
verse.lines:
I'll sing our God never fails
Our God never fails

verse.name: v2a
verse.lines:
With hope and light
You reign over all

verse.name: v2b
verse.lines:
Though my heart may fail
You will always be

verse.name: v2c
verse.lines:
I'll sing our God never fails
Our God never fails

verse.name: p1a
verse.lines:
Praise in the morning
Praise in the evening

verse.name: p1b
verse.lines:
Praise when I'm laughing
Praise when I'm grieving

verse.name: p1c
verse.lines:
There will be dancing
There will be singing

verse.name: p1d
verse.lines: Upon injustice we will tell of our God

verse.name: c1a
verse.lines:
The hope of all hearts
The hope of all hearts is You

verse.name: c1b
verse.lines:
Your love never fails
Your love never fails

verse.name: b1a
verse.lines:
In darkness, in trial
My soul shall sing

verse.name: b1b
verse.lines:
Of His mercy and kindness
Our offering of praise

verse.name: b1c
verse.lines:
Our God never fails
Our God never fails
